_comment: Phone: Irwin (the superfan who doesn't know who The Feds are).
1:
You the BEST I EVER scrapped!Huh? You the one who saved all the
SLOWPOKE?No wonder I couldn't beat you!
Could I get your number?I don't wanna miss NOTHIN' you do from
now on! NOTHIN'! {YESNO 0}
2: SHEESH! Good looks!\rNow I can call you ANYTIME, whether\nanythin' goin' on or not.\fJust to chat! Every day! Hourly!
3: Oh, but...\nI ain't dangerous!\rI just wanna call and chat about\neverythin' and nothin'!\fAnd know where you are. At all times.
5: Huh? Wait, ain't you right nearby?\nI know. I can see you. Hi!
6: {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}, you heard?\rGoldenrod's Radio Tower got taken\nover by The Feds!\r...Wait, like the REAL feds?\nI ain't even do nothin'! I'm hidin'!
8: {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}, I heard!\nYou beat Whitney?\rIt make me proud to be your homie!\nI made a scrapbook! Call you later!
10:
I saw, I heard!You beat Morty of Ecruteak Block!
Th-that's CRAZY!I went to the Block's entrance to cheer
you on.But everybody had candles on their
heads, it was kinda creepy...So I punked out and ran home... I cheered from my room. LOUD.Call you later!
12: Ayo, I heard about you!\rYou saved that homie at the Lighthouse,\ndidn't you?\r{STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}, I wish you'd come see me when\nI'm sick in bed!\fI'm not sick. I could BE sick.\rCall you later!
14: I heard, I heard, I heard!\rYou ran up in The Feds' hideout!\nYou like a movie hero, even!\rBut, um... Was they the REAL feds?\rI deleted my whole search history\njust in case.
16: I heard, I heard, I heard!\rAbout how you freed the Radio Tower!\nYou go SO hard!\rI just wanted to make sure you knew\nyou AWESOME!\fI made a song about it. 11 minutes.\rCall you later!
18: I saw, I saw, I saw you, {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}!\nI saw you go in the Dragon's Den!\rI KNOW you passed! Ain't no need to be\nhumble! You can't fail!\fI was in the bushes. Supportively.\rCall you later!
20: Yesterday I went to New Bark Town.\nThere was a lady who looked a lot like\fyou, {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}.\rWhat? That lady was your MOM?\nAww, I shoulda introduced myself!\fI waved. From across the street.\fFor an hour.\rCall you later!
22: I saw, I saw, I saw!\rYou walkin' onto a ship, {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}!\rYou look SO good with the sea behind\nyou!\fI took 300 pictures.\rI HATE havin' to hang up on you!\nCall you later!
24:
I heard, I heard!You got a Magnet Train Pass!When I saw you leavin' on the ship, I
was sad I wouldn't see you for a while.But since you got that Pass, you can
zip back anytime! That's a relief!What? You can Catch Flight back
anytime?What's that?Call you later!
26: I saw, I saw!\rYou wakin' up SNORLAX!\rI was watchin' from far away, so I\ncouldn't see exactly.\fThe binoculars was foggy.\rYou played a flute to wake it?\nSHEESH! That's like magic!\rCall you later!
28: {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}, I heard!\rYou kickin' up a crazy ruckus over\nin Kanto!\rWhat a glorious rampage it must be!\nYou go SO hard!\rCall you later!

I hear gossip about you all over the
place.It just make me sigh, {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}.
How you get so strong?Go for the world championship now!
I'll ALWAYS be cheerin' for you!Call you later! ...Is that OK? Please say it's OK.
